clips.title: Progress
paras: Welcome priest. The Eye of Zuldazar pulses with energy. You are ready to take the next step. Hand me the talisman and I shall perform the imbue.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Continue in your battle against the Soulflayer and his minions, friend. He must never be permitted to leave the confines of Zul'Gurub.
